name: Shaman's Sanctuary -Miko no Seiiki-
original_name: しゃーまんず・さんくちゅあり－巫女の聖域－
source:
You play as Mafune Itsuki, an ordinary guy visiting his tsundere childhood friend Hino Mizuno, who is a respected priestess and wants Itsuki to crossdress and join her temple as a "god". He healed Mizuno once thanks to his secret powers, and she wants him to use them again. But, if Itsuki uses them in a battle with Mizuno as his partner, there'll be some perverted consequences...

[Based on [url=http://verbalrubbish.oniichannoecchi.com/?p=3915#more-3915]Verbal Rubbish[/url]]

Post-war Japan makes religion a mandatory part of education to heal those with wounded hearts. A few decades later, Japan is 99% religious with many different religions, some of which cause problems with their illegal recruitment of followers. The government decides to unite all the religions by selecting the ‘god amongst gods’. Itsuki has the power to heal injured people. His childhood friend Mizuno knows about his special ability since he saved her in the past and she persuades him to join the battle. Itsuki summons protection mikos to battle with mikos from other religions. However, there is an unusual side effect where he gets sexually aroused when he uses his powers.

[From[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/11/04/november-2010-eroge-releases/] Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
玩家将扮演真船树，一名普通青年。他前去拜访傲娇青梅竹马日野水乃。水乃是一位备受敬重的巫女，希望树男扮女装，以“神明”的身份加入她的神社。树过去曾凭借自己的秘密力量治好水乃，她希望他再次使用那股力量。然而，如果树以水乃为搭档参加战斗，就会产生某些色情后果…

[Based on [url=http://verbalrubbish.oniichannoecchi.com/?p=3915#more-3915]Verbal Rubbish[/url]]

战后日本为治愈心灵受创的人们，把宗教列为教育的必修内容。数十年后，日本已有99%的人信奉宗教，教派种类繁多，其中一些还因非法招募信徒而引发问题。政府决定选出“众神之神”，借此统一所有宗教。树拥有治愈伤者的能力。青梅竹马水乃知道他的特殊能力，因为过去正是他救了她，并说服他参加这场战斗。树召唤护卫巫女，与其他宗教的巫女交战。然而，他使用力量时会出现一种异常副作用：身体会产生性兴奋。
